title: Chapter 238 Assassination
content:
Chapter 238 Assassination

After a few months, Heifu came outside the governor's mansion again and found that the atmosphere here was just like other areas of Jiangling City, solemn and vigilant.

The undefended city of Jiangling in the past was militarized like Ying County. The Qin soldiers who had just finished repelling Meng Xia's offensive from Chu State turned into a city defense brigade, patrolling the roads in the city with spears in hand. , the lively evening market in the city has been cancelled, the curfew has lasted all night, the doors and windows of every house are closed, and the streets seem a little lonely...

In front of the gate of the governor's mansion, there are also hundreds of famous generals and hundreds of people guarding the door, and there are people stationed all over the wall with crossbows. Once anyone acting suspiciously approaches without permission, they can be shot on the spot!

Looking at the crossbows in the hands of the officials, Heifu seemed to have seen yesterday's scene again: when an assassin suddenly appeared in a wealthy family's house beside the road and fired a crossbow from the window at the carriage where the county guard and the county lieutenant were riding together, the bodyguard suddenly The soldiers did not rush to stop him, but the county guard and the county lieutenant fell to the ground together!

But then, Li You stood up immediately. He had not yet taken off his armor, and it would be fine even if he was directly hit by the crossbow arrow. He subconsciously knocked the county guard down together.

But he allowed Ye Teng to avoid the vital point, but failed to make him unscathed. The young county lieutenant had never encountered such a situation before. His expression was a little dazed, and his eyes were fixed on the county lieutenant who was still lying in the car. Shou, I don’t know what to do. "Hel me up!"

It wasn't until Ye Teng cursed in a low voice that Li You reacted and immediately helped the governor up.

Ye Teng didn't seem to have anything wrong at all. He shook off Li You's hand, straightened his crown, and glanced contemptuously at the assassin who was shot into a sieve by the guards' counterattack after the assassination and fell from the window. , commanded with a calm expression.

He first asked everyone to shout, "The assassin has been brought to justice! The county guard and the county lieutenant are safe and sound." He calmed the people's fear, and then asked people to quickly seal off the area and apprehend the assassin's accomplices, and then let the charioteer move on.

"My Lord, are you galloping back to the Sheriff's Mansion?" The charioteer who knew the inside story asked fearfully.

"No, follow the planned route and walk slowly."

Ye Teng closed his eyes. It seemed that the assassination he had just experienced was just a breeze blowing on his face. Only the guards nearby could notice that although Li You pretended to be fine, his palms were quietly supporting the county. Mamoru's back...

Under the protection of Li You personally holding a shield, Ye Teng insisted on completing the planned route. Although his lips were a little pale and his hands were trembling, the people far away knew nothing about it and were all celebrating that the commander was safe.

It wasn't until he arrived at the Sheriff's Mansion, where the public couldn't see it, that Li Youcai asked Heifu to quickly board the car and bandage the Sheriff!

It turned out that the arrow had penetrated deeply into Ye Teng's left leg. Hei Fu couldn't help but be shocked. After hurriedly treating him to stop the bleeding, he discovered that the arrow cluster seemed to have been specially treated. There was a peculiar smell in the wound, and the position where the arrow cluster penetrated Somewhat black!

The doctors who came after hearing the inquiry had heavy faces, thinking that the arrow clusters were poisonous! So they discussed countermeasures in a low voice.

At this time, Jin, the county guard's daughter, also came over in a hurry. When she saw her father was injured, she did not burst into tears like an ordinary woman. Instead, with tears in her eyes, she asked the county lieutenant and the county magistrate to handle the affairs. Don't delay here and stay. Chang Shi Ludang can take care of you here.

Then, the girl dressed in plain clothes came to Heihu again, bowed to him and said, "Father's injury cannot be delayed. The doctors in the county governor's house are good at treating diseases, but they are not good at taking medicine or food medicine." Treating Jin Chuang. I heard that Chen Jun, a disciple of Duke Xia, the imperial physician, is in Jiangling! He is a colleague of Cao Shi, Zuo Bing. I hope Cao Shi, Zuo Bing, can invite him here quickly! "

The girl hit the mark, and Hei Fu also calmed down. After accepting the promise, he immediately went to Chen Wujiu, a doctor who specializes in treating golden sores...

Because the Chu army's offensive started but failed, dozens of medical and emergency personnel who were originally planned to be sent to the Chaling battlefield to test the effect were unable to make the trip and are still stationed in Jiangling City.

When Heifu followed Tang Jue and pushed away the house that Chen Wujiu strictly prohibited anyone from breaking into, he was shocked.

The whole room smelled of smoke, but Chen Wujiu was seen sitting in front of the desk, burning the leaves of a certain plant on the lit candle. When the dry leaf rolls were lit, streams of green smoke floated away. After getting up, Chen Wujiu took a deep breath greedily and showed an expression of extreme enjoyment.

That's right, Hei Fu, who had destroyed dens with him during his internship in his previous life, undoubtedly recognized it as marijuana!

Hei Fu was furious and immediately walked over, grabbed Chen Wu Jiu and slapped him twice on the left and right!

"I asked you to experiment with narcotics to benefit the world, but you smoked them!"

..."Heifu?"

Chen Wujiu received two big slaps from Hei Fu, and his blurred eyes finally became clear. He didn't care about settling accounts with Hei Fu. He covered his aching cheek and said happily: "You're back? You're here just in time, hurry up." Come and see what I've found!"

After Chen Wujiu's excited narration, Heifu realized that it turned out that during the rest of the month when he went to participate in the April County Tour, Chen Wujiu, in addition to continuing to train medical and first aid personnel, still did not give up searching for capable people in the wild. Hallucinogenic wild marijuana.

As a result, he actually found some wild cannabis plants on the bank of Yunmeng Ze!

After two months of trying, Chen Wujiu has also changed the practice of letting his young disciples taste cannabis flowers and leaves directly. He found inspiration from the common moxibustion fire, dried the cannabis leaves and burned them with fire. , and then inhale the green smoke.

The green smoke of the hemp leaves used in the fields to extract fiber from the stems for weaving was insignificant, but the hemp leaves found in Yunmengze had shorter stems and larger leaves, which made Chen Wujiu's heart beat faster. A feeling of euphoria!

He was overjoyed, thinking that he had found the kind of magical cannabis that Heifu described as "making you sleepy when you eat it", so he had all the growing dwarf cannabis harvested and began to study day and night.

"Taking the flowers and leaves of this kind of cannabis alone has no effect. I tried it dozens of times before I found out that mixing eggplant and cannabis flowers, which can reduce the pain caused by moxibustion, can really make me sleepy. A few hours! I was fine after waking up!"

As he said that, Chen Wujiu pointed at the unlucky disciple who was sleeping soundly on the mat. This young apprentice must have become his test subject again. I wonder if Xia Wuji used his disciples in this way back then.

Of course, Chen Wujiu also seems to be obsessed with smoking marijuana leaves. Whenever he takes a sip when he is sleepy, he will be energetic and continue to study this great discovery in the medical field...

Hei Fu looked at Chen Wujiu's sunken eye sockets, and it looked like he had lost a lot of weight. He didn't know whether he had lost weight by concentrating on studying, or by smoking marijuana.

He no longer cared about so much and immediately told Chen Wu Jiu about the fact that the county guard was injured in the assassination and the arrow cluster might be poisonous.

Marijuana is not highly toxic, so Chen Wujiu completely woke up after washing his face with cold water. Listening to Heifu's narration, his face became more and more serious. "I'll go immediately!"

After saying that, Chen Wujiu kicked the disciple a few times. When he saw that the disciple couldn't do it anymore, he personally hung up the medicine bag, which contained his various silver needles, moxibustion, knives and other tools. However, when he was about to go out, I went back and brought two bags with me! "What is this?" Heifu asked. "This is the new medicine I told you about, which I have developed over the past month!" Chen Wujiu said mysteriously:

"Although it is chewable, it is different from the poisonous wine recipe used by Bian Que, but it has the same effect! I have given it a new name, and it is called Sleeping Saint Powder!"

…

That day, when Chen Wu Jiu arrived and examined the leg of Sheriff Teng Zhongjian, he discovered that it was not poison, but gold juice...

"Gold juice?" The county guard's daughter's eyes were red. She must have cried secretly, but she still behaved very gracefully and capable in front of others. It is amazing that a girl under fifteen years old can do this.

Heifu explained in a low voice: "It's dung juice. The assassin probably didn't have any ready-made poison at hand, so he soaked the arrow clusters with it. As a result, the wounds of the soldiers hit by the arrows were rotten and difficult to heal. This is very important in the battle of defending and attacking a city." I often see..."

In the previous battle to defend the city of Yi Dao, Heifu and the others also used this method. Many Ba people died of wound infection after being shot by arrows. They paid the price for their rash resistance to Qin. Who would have expected that the assassin would also use this method? trick.

Since it is not a poison that seals the throat at the sight of blood, which only appears in martial arts, it is much easier to deal with. However, the infected flesh and blood around the wound needs to be cut off with a hot knife! "After all, my father is old and no longer what he used to be. I'm afraid he can't bear such severe pain."

Looking at the somewhat confused Sheriff Teng, Zi Jin showed a rare girlish attitude and tightened his wide silk sleeves. Her mother died young, so the girl's mind was relatively precocious. If her father had passed away before she was old enough, the blow would undoubtedly be huge.

At this time, Chen Wu Jiu saw the right opportunity and immediately bowed down and presented the "Sleeping Saint Powder" he had developed!

Heifu didn't have time to hold him back, so he couldn't help but cursed secretly. Did Dr. Chen smoke too much marijuana, or was he eager to achieve success? He was so impulsive. He had only tried this thing on himself and the little disciple. Although he was fine, if Ye Teng couldn't wake up after eating it, what the assassin couldn't do could be done with his hands as a doctor. Wouldn't it be wrong? laugh?

Unexpectedly, Chen Wu Jiu boasted that this medicine was Bian Que's recipe. After Hei Fu's reminder, he rediscovered it. He repeatedly assured that he had tried this medicine himself and that he would be able to wake up after a few hours without any symptoms. What side effects.

Zi Jin glanced at Hei Fu in surprise, thoughtfully, and after much hesitation, she saluted Chen Wu Jiu and said:

"Although Zijin doesn't know medical skills, he has heard that doctors can't cure it. People who don't believe in medicine will not cure it. Of all the doctors here today, Dr. Chen is the only one who can treat this sore and save my father from pain. How dare you not believe it? Please also ask the doctors to try their best to administer medicine!”

In the end, the "Sleeping Saint Powder" invented by Chen Wujiu proved its effectiveness. Ye Teng accepted Chen Wujiu's flesh-cutting operation in a comatose state. After cleaning the wound and bandaging it properly, Chen Wujiu Jiu and Heifu both hoped that Ye Teng would wake up quickly.

Unexpectedly, the efficacy of Sleeping Saint Powder seemed to be deviated, and Ye Teng slept all night long!

This frightened the two of them so much that Chen Wujiu lost his previous confidence and murmured that it was probably because different people have different constitutions, so there were differences.

Fortunately, early this morning, Heifu finally got the news that the Sheriff had woken up, and hurried to the Sheriff's Mansion...

The mansion was heavily guarded. Heifu showed his copper seal and yellow ribbon and the governor's biography before he could enter. He found that there were five posts, one post and ten posts in the mansion. The former slaves and maids couldn't help but take it easy. Footsteps, dare not speak loudly...

However, when Hei Fu walked to the study room where he met Sheriff Ye for the first time, he heard Sheriff Teng's angry shout coming from inside.

"Confused!"
